types.task_completed_with_cracks: Fires when a task finishes; despite the key name, whether cracks are required to trigger it depends on the taskReportMode setting.

settings.taskReportMode: Controls whether the 'task completed' notification fires for every task, or only when it found at least one crack.

agentOffline.bufferMinutes: Minutes to wait after an agent disconnects before sending an offline alert, to avoid false alarms from brief network blips.

globalWebhook.secret: HMAC signing secret used so the receiver can verify the webhook payload really came from this server; not a password.

webhooks.secret: HMAC signing secret used so the receiver can verify the webhook payload really came from this server; not a password.
